context: A police officer briefs on international cooperation
purpose: Teach: 親善/発祥/庁舎/受動/刑罰/緊迫/牽引/症例

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 国際親善のフォーラム、警察庁も参加します。
lines.en: The National Police Agency will be participating in an international goodwill forum.
lines.style: Measured, informative. Opens with professional clarity. Steady pace, even weight on each phrase. Slight pause before the final clause for emphasis. No rush — the kind of precise delivery that signals official but not cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察制度の発祥、各国で異なりますね。
lines.en: Police systems have different origins in different countries, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful lean-in. Speaks as if working through an idea aloud. Slightly softer attack on the opening. Genuine curiosity — not challenging, genuinely wondering. Pace relaxes on the question tag.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。庁舎前で記念撮影、予定しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to take a commemorative photo in front of the building.
lines.style: Back to procedural tone. Matter-of-fact, slightly more formal than before. Clear syllables on the logistical details. Steady eye contact level. Not unfriendly, just — this is the plan.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 受動的な国際対応、変えるべきとの議論もありますね。
lines.en: There's debate about whether that passive approach to international engagement should change, isn't there?
lines.style: Careful wording, testing ground. Softer attack — this is a sensitive point. Pace slows slightly on the observation. Breathing suggests he's reading Officer Takeda's response as he speaks. Not aggressive — genuinely probing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。刑罰の比較研究、緊迫した時代に重要です。
lines.en: Yes. Comparative research on sentencing practices is important in times like these.
lines.style: Firmer than the previous response. Weight settles on 「重要」. This matters and he's making sure it registers. Still measured, but conviction underneath. Slight nod in the voice — not just information, but principle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察庁が牽引する役割、注目されていますね。
lines.en: The NPA's leadership role in this is getting quite a bit of attention.
lines.style: Softer observation. Ren's offering this as factual noting, not challenge. Slight rising note on 「注目」 — he's genuinely noticing the shift. Pace is conversational again. Almost deferential in tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。特殊な症例、各国で共有しています。
lines.en: Yes. We're sharing specialized cases and findings across international partners.
lines.style: Confident close. Weight on the concrete work — 「特殊な症例」. Slightly slower, deliberate. This is the substance beneath the forum. Steady finish, no trailing. Finality in the tone — this concludes the point.
